AI-Powered Green Infrastructure Recommendations

🌳

Suggested Trees

Native, drought-resistant trees like Oak and Maple for maximum cooling effect and biodiversity.

🌿

Recommended Grass

Hardy perennial grasses such as Fescue and Bermuda to contribute to ground cooling.

🎋

Shrub Density

Low-lying shrubs ideal for reducing soil temperature and preventing erosion.

💧

Water Retention

Bioswales and permeable pavements to manage stormwater runoff and replenish groundwater.

Data-Driven Planning for a Sustainable Future

Urban Heat Islands (UHI) are a critical consequence of climate change and rapid urbanization. Concrete jungles trap heat, leading to increased energy consumption and health risks. GreenScape AI tackles this challenge head-on. By leveraging high-resolution satellite imagery and advanced machine learning, we provide city planners with the precise data they need to make strategic decisions.
